description: Desired NetworkPolicy settings and placement metadata.

behavior: Applies a NetworkPolicy using the raw Kubernetes spec provided in policy.
gotchas: The policy field is passed through without schema validation by this API.
NetworkPolicy behavior depends on the cluster CNI implementation.

namespace.description: Namespace where the NetworkPolicy will be created.

tier.description: Tier used for labeling and policy selection.

cluster.description: Logical cluster identifier used for labeling and placement.

owner.description: Owning team or service for accountability and routing.

policy.description: Raw NetworkPolicy spec (podSelector, ingress, egress, etc.).
